# Configuration reference

Orcon reads its settings from four places, highest first: command-line flags, `ORCON_*` environment variables, the YAML file passed with `--config` (or `ORCON_CONFIG`), and built-in defaults. Each key is resolved on its own.

- YAML keys are camelCase; unknown keys are errors.
- Environment names are `ORCON_` plus the key path in UPPER_SNAKE (`store.postgres.maxConnections` becomes `ORCON_STORE_POSTGRES_MAX_CONNECTIONS`). Exceptions: `ORCON_PUBLIC_URL`, `ORCON_MASTER_KEY`, `ORCON_MASTER_KEY_BACKUP_ACK`. Lists are comma-separated. An unknown `ORCON_*` variable is a warning, because the command-line client shares the prefix.
- Flags are the key path in kebab-case (`--store-postgres-max-connections`).
- Secrets can be read from files: `dsnFile` in YAML, `ORCON_STORE_POSTGRES_DSN_FILE` in the environment, `--store-postgres-dsn-file` as a flag. Secret values are never accepted as flags. One trailing line break is removed from the file. Giving a secret and its file variant at the same level is an error.
- Run `orcon config check` to see every effective value, where it came from, and any error. Secrets are shown as `[REDACTED]`.
- The server configuration file is never named `orcon.yaml`; that name belongs to flows-as-code repositories.
- Keys marked `live` are reread when the process receives `SIGHUP`; the others need a restart.

## Settings

### General

#### `role`

The part of Orcon this process runs: standalone (everything, with SQLite), or api, scheduler and worker as separate processes (PostgreSQL).

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | one of `standalone`, `api`, `scheduler`, `worker` |
| Default | `standalone` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_ROLE` |
| Flag | `--role` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `dataDir`

Directory where Orcon keeps its local state: the SQLite database, filesystem blobs, the master key file and temporary files.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | path |
| Default | Linux: $XDG_DATA_HOME/orcon or ~/.local/share/orcon; macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Orcon; Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Orcon; container image: /var/lib/orcon |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_DATA_DIR` |
| Flag | `--data-dir` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `publicUrl`

The address users type to reach Orcon. It is used in links, cookies and the first-run URL. Outside localhost it must be https://.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | URL |
| Default | `http://127.0.0.1:8080` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_PUBLIC_URL` |
| Flag | `--public-url` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | `standalone`, `api` |

### `http`

#### `http.address`

Address the HTTP server listens on, as host:port. The default listens on the loopback interface only.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | host:port |
| Default | `127.0.0.1:8080` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_HTTP_ADDRESS` |
| Flag | `--http-address` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | `standalone`, `api` |

#### `http.tls.certificateFile`

Path of the PEM certificate chain. With http.tls.keyFile, the server terminates TLS itself.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | path |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_HTTP_TLS_CERTIFICATE_FILE` |
| Flag | `--http-tls-certificate-file` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | `standalone`, `api` |

#### `http.tls.keyFile`

Path of the PEM private key of the certificate. The file holds the key; this setting is only its path.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | path |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_HTTP_TLS_KEY_FILE` |
| Flag | `--http-tls-key-file` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | `standalone`, `api` |

#### `http.trustedProxies`

Networks (CIDR) of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-* headers are trusted. Empty trusts none.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | list |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_HTTP_TRUSTED_PROXIES` |
| Flag | `--http-trusted-proxies` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | `standalone`, `api` |

#### `http.shutdownTimeout`

How long the process waits for requests and work in flight to finish after SIGTERM before it exits.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | duration |
| Default | `30s` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_HTTP_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` |
| Flag | `--http-shutdown-timeout` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | `standalone`, `api` |

| Takes effect | after a restart |

| Type | number, from 0.5 to 0.95 |
| Default | `0.9` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_RUNTIME_MEMORY_LIMIT_RATIO` |
| Flag | `--runtime-memory-limit-ratio` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

| Type | one of `FULL`, `NORMAL` |
| Default | `FULL` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_STORE_SQLITE_SYNCHRONOUS` |
| Flag | `--store-sqlite-synchronous` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | `standalone` |

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_STORE_POSTGRES_DSN` |
| Flag | none (secret) |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |
| Secret | yes. File variant: YAML `store.postgres.dsnFile`, environment `ORCON_STORE_POSTGRES_DSN_FILE`, flag `--store-postgres-dsn-file`. |

Maximum number of connections this process opens to PostgreSQL.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | integer, from 1 to 1000 |
| Default | `20` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_STORE_POSTGRES_MAX_CONNECTIONS` |
| Flag | `--store-postgres-max-connections` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `store.postgres.declaredCapacity`

Disk capacity of the database, for example 500GiB, used to warn before it fills. Empty means Orcon does not know it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | bytes |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_STORE_POSTGRES_DECLARED_CAPACITY` |
| Flag | `--store-postgres-declared-capacity` |
| Takes effect | live (on SIGHUP) |
| Roles | all |

#### `store.migrations.auto`

Apply pending database migrations when the process starts, when that is safe for the processes already running. Turn it off to migrate with orcon store schema apply.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_STORE_MIGRATIONS_AUTO` |
| Flag | `--store-migrations-auto` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

| Type | integer, from 1 to 8 |
| Default | `1` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_BACKUP_POSTGRES_PARALLELISM` |
| Flag | `--backup-postgres-parallelism` |
| Takes effect | live (on SIGHUP) |
| Roles | `standalone`, `scheduler` |

#### `backup.beforeUpgrade`

Take a local backup before a startup migration changes the schema.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | true with store.driver sqlite; false with store.driver postgres |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_BACKUP_BEFORE_UPGRADE` |
| Flag | `--backup-before-upgrade` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | `standalone`, `scheduler` |

#### `backup.verify.schedule`

Cron expression, in UTC, of the automatic verification of the latest backup. Empty means no scheduled verification.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_BACKUP_VERIFY_SCHEDULE` |
| Flag | `--backup-verify-schedule` |
| Takes effect | live (on SIGHUP) |
| Roles | `standalone`, `scheduler` |

#### `backup.verify.postgres.dsn`

Connection string of a scratch PostgreSQL database where backups are restored to verify them. Orcon empties it before and after. Without it, PostgreSQL backups are verified only at archive level.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_BACKUP_VERIFY_POSTGRES_DSN` |
| Flag | none (secret) |
| Takes effect | live (on SIGHUP) |
| Roles | `standalone`, `scheduler` |
| Secret | yes. File variant: YAML `backup.verify.postgres.dsnFile`, environment `ORCON_BACKUP_VERIFY_POSTGRES_DSN_FILE`, flag `--backup-verify-postgres-dsn-file`. |

### `observability`

#### `observability.metrics.prometheus.enabled`

Serve metrics in the Prometheus format at /metrics on the operations listener (ops.address).

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `false` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_METRICS_PROMETHEUS_ENABLED` |
| Flag | `--observability-metrics-prometheus-enabled` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `observability.otlp.endpoint`

Address of the OpenTelemetry collector that receives metrics, traces and logs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | string |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_OTLP_ENDPOINT` |
| Flag | `--observability-otlp-endpoint` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `observability.otlp.protocol`

Protocol used to talk to the collector.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | one of `grpc`, `http` |
| Default | `grpc` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_OTLP_PROTOCOL` |
| Flag | `--observability-otlp-protocol` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `observability.otlp.insecure`

Talk to the collector without TLS. Use only on a trusted network.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `false` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_OTLP_INSECURE` |
| Flag | `--observability-otlp-insecure` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `observability.otlp.headers`

Headers sent to the collector, as name=value pairs. They often carry an API token, so they are a secret.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | map |
| Default | none |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_OTLP_HEADERS` |
| Flag | none (secret) |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |
| Secret | yes. File variant: YAML `observability.otlp.headersFile`, environment `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_OTLP_HEADERS_FILE`, flag `--observability-otlp-headers-file`. |

#### `observability.metrics.otlp.enabled`

Export metrics to the collector.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `false` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_METRICS_OTLP_ENABLED` |
| Flag | `--observability-metrics-otlp-enabled` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `observability.traces.otlp.enabled`

Export traces to the collector.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `false` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_TRACES_OTLP_ENABLED` |
| Flag | `--observability-traces-otlp-enabled` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `observability.logs.otlp.enabled`

Export logs to the collector.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `false` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_LOGS_OTLP_ENABLED` |
| Flag | `--observability-logs-otlp-enabled` |
| Takes effect | after a restart |
| Roles | all |

#### `observability.traces.sampleRatio`

Fraction of traces that are recorded, from 0 (none) to 1 (all).

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | number, from 0 to 1 |

| Environment variable | `ORCON_OBSERVABILITY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATIO` |

| Takes effect | live (on SIGHUP) |

### `updateCheck`

#### `updateCheck.enabled`

Check for new Orcon releases. Off by default: Orcon never contacts the project on its own. When on, it reads the public release list and sends nothing about the installation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `false` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED` |
| Flag | `--update-check-enabled` |
| Takes effect | live (on SIGHUP) |
| Roles | all |

#### `updateCheck.url`

Address of the public list of releases that the update check reads.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | URL |
| Default | `https://api.github.com/repos/wirvii/orcon/releases` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_UPDATE_CHECK_URL` |
| Flag | `--update-check-url` |
| Takes effect | live (on SIGHUP) |
| Roles | all |

#### `updateCheck.interval`

How often the update check runs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | duration |
| Default | `24h` |
| Environment variable | `ORCON_UPDATE_CHECK_INTERVAL` |
| Flag | `--update-check-interval` |
| Takes effect | live (on SIGHUP) |
| Roles | all |
